en: Changed Code Mode so a PreToolUse hook that errors no longer refuses a script's tool call, as outside Code Mode; set `"onFailure": "block"` on a command, HTTP or MCP tool hook that must refuse
zh: 变更 Code Mode：出错的 PreToolUse hook 不再像 Code Mode 之外那样拒绝脚本的工具调用；对于必须拒绝的命令、HTTP 或 MCP 工具 hook，请设置 `"onFailure": "block"`
